Saraswatarishta.ingredients: 19 Main Ingredients : Bacopa monnieri, Ipomoea mauritiana, Asparagus racemosus, Honey, Sugar, Merrimia turpethum, Acorus calamus, Withania somnifera, Tinospora cordifolia, Embelia ribes, Gold (24 carat-processed)

Chyavanaprasha.safety_note: Contains sugar and honey: caution in diabetes. Heavy-metal content has been questioned for some Ayurvedic products; one 2011 consumer test found major brands acceptable.
Chyavanaprasha.evidence_note: Widely used; small studies on immunity and respiratory outcomes exist but high-quality trials are scarce.

Brahma Rasayana.ingredients: 45 Main ingredients : Terminalia chebula, Emblica officinalis, Aegle marmelos, Oroxylum indicum, Gmelina arborea, Sugar, cow’sGhee, Gingely oil, Honey

Brahma Rasayana.evidence_note: Only traditional use plus limited preclinical research; no solid clinical trials found.

Agastya Rasayana.ingredients: 27 Main Ingredients : Dasamoolarn, Kaempferia galanga, Sida cordifolia, Clerodendrum serratum, Hordeum vulgare, Terminalia chebula, Jaggery, Cow ghee, Gingelly oil, Honey, Piper longum
Agastya Rasayana.safety_note: Contains jaggery, ghee and honey: caution in diabetes.
Agastya Rasayana.evidence_note: Traditional use only; no robust clinical trials found.

Brahmi Ghrita.ingredients: 12 Main Ingredients : Bacopa monnieri, Thrikatu, Merrimia turpethum, Baliospermum montanum, Clitoria ternatea, Cassia fistula, Embelia ribes, Cow ghee
Brahmi Ghrita.safety_note: Ghee base: caution with high cholesterol. Bacopa may cause nausea and gut upset.
Brahmi Ghrita.evidence_note: Bacopa has limited and inconsistent evidence for cognition; this ghee is untested clinically.

Kalyanaka Ghrita.ingredients: 29 Main Ingredients : Thriphala, Citrullus colocynthis, Curcuma longa, Desmodium gangeticum, Embelia ribes, Punica granatum, Baliospermum montanum, Santalum album, Cow ghee
Kalyanaka Ghrita.safety_note: Ghee base: caution with high cholesterol; physician supervision advised for epilepsy or infertility.

Mahatiktaka Ghrita.ingredients: 34 Main Ingredients : Alstonia scholaris, Thriphala, Cassia fistula, Coscinium fenestraatum, Azadirachta indica, Santalum album, Citrullus colocynthis, Tinospora cordifolia, Trichosanthes anguina, Aconitum heterophyllum, Emblica officinalis, Cow ghee
Mahatiktaka Ghrita.safety_note: Ghee base: caution with high cholesterol.
Mahatiktaka Ghrita.evidence_note: Traditional use only; limited small studies.

Narayana Taila.safety_note: Mainly external; avoid on broken skin or in fever and acute inflammation unless advised.

Dhanvantaram Taila.ingredients: 48 Main Ingredients : Sida cordifolia, Hordeum vulgare, Ziziphus jujuba, Horse gram, Dasamoolam, Asparagus racemosus, Rubia cordifolia, Withania somnifera, Hemidesmus indicus, Santalum album, Ipomoea mauritiana, Acorus calamus, Rock salt, Asphaltum, Boerrhavia diffusa, Thriphala, Chathurjathakam, Gingelly oil, Cow milk
Dhanvantaram Taila.safety_note: Mainly external; patch-test first; oral use only under supervision.

Mahamasha Taila.evidence_note: Traditional use only; no robust clinical trials found.

Kottamchukkadi Taila.ingredients: 12 Main Ingredients : Tamarindus indica (Leaves), Saussurea lappa, Dried ginger, Acorus calamus, Allium sativum, Alpinia calcarata, Gingelly oil, Curd
Kottamchukkadi Taila.safety_note: External use only; garlic may irritate sensitive skin; patch-test.
Kottamchukkadi Taila.evidence_note: Traditional use only; no robust clinical trials found.

Chandraprabha Vati.ingredients: 36 Main Ingredients : Embelia ribes.Thrikatu, Thriphala, Acorus calamus, Rock salt, Potassium carbonate, Aconitum heterophyllum, Asphaltum, Commiphora wightii (purified), Eclipta alba
Chandraprabha Vati.safety_note: Contains shilajit and guggulu; metal content concerns generally apply to Ayurvedic mineral products; guggul may affect thyroid and drug metabolism (CYP3A4); caution in pregnancy.
Chandraprabha Vati.evidence_note: Traditional use with a few small trials in urinary symptoms and diabetes, low quality.

Kaishora Guggulu.ingredients: 15 Main Ingredients : Commiphora wightii (purified), Thriphala, Tinospora cordifolia, Thrikatu, Embelia ribes, Baliospermum montanum, Merrimia turpethum, Cow ghee
Kaishora Guggulu.safety_note: Guggul can interact with CYP3A4 drugs, affect thyroid tests, cause GI upset, and rarely liver injury; caution in pregnancy.
Kaishora Guggulu.evidence_note: Traditional use only; guggul evidence mixed.

Kanchanara Guggulu.ingredients: 15 Main ingredients : Bauhinia variegata, Terminalia chebula, Terminalia bellerica, Emblica officinalis, Commiphora wightii etc
Kanchanara Guggulu.safety_note: Guggul may alter thyroid hormones and CYP3A4 drug levels; see physician if on thyroid medication or in pregnancy.
Kanchanara Guggulu.evidence_note: Traditional use only; no robust clinical trials found.

Triphala Guggulu.safety_note: Guggul may interact with CYP3A4 drugs and thyroid tests; caution in pregnancy.
Triphala Guggulu.evidence_note: Traditional use only; triphala has small studies, guggul evidence is mixed.

Yogaraja Guggulu.ingredients: 28 Main Ingredients : Plumbago rosea, Cuminum cyminum, Embelia ribes, Cedrus deodara, Rock salt, Alpinia calcarata, Tribulus terrestris, Thriphala, Thrikatu, Potassi carbonas, Commiphora wightii (purified)
Yogaraja Guggulu.safety_note: Some versions contain metals (bhasma) in the full classical recipe; guggul may interact with CYP3A4 drugs and thyroid tests; caution in pregnancy.
Yogaraja Guggulu.evidence_note: Traditional use; a few small trials in arthritis, low quality.

Punarnava Guggulu.ingredients: 20 Ingredients : Boerhavia diffusa, Ricinus communis, Zingiber officinalis, Castor oil etc
Punarnava Guggulu.safety_note: Guggul may interact with CYP3A4 drugs and thyroid tests; caution in pregnancy.
Punarnava Guggulu.evidence_note: Traditional use only; no robust clinical trials found.

Sudarshana Churna.ingredients: 54 Ingredients : Thriphala, Cyperus rotundus, Solanum xanthocarpum, Kaempferia galanga, Thrikatu, Tinospora cordifolia, Piccrorrhiza curroa, Oldenlandia corymbosa, Azadirachta indica, Clerodendrum serratum, Desmodium gangeticum, Pseudarthria viscida, Abies spectabilis, Andrographis paniculata
Sudarshana Churna.safety_note: Very bitter; may upset the stomach; caution in pregnancy.
Sudarshana Churna.evidence_note: Traditional use; limited small studies of components such as Andrographis.

Trikatu Churna.ingredients: 3 Main ingredients : Zingiber officinale, Piper nigrum, Piper Iongum
Trikatu Churna.safety_note: Pungent; may aggravate acidity or ulcers; piperine can increase absorption of some drugs.
Trikatu Churna.evidence_note: Mostly traditional use plus piperine bioavailability research.

Hinguvachadi Churna.ingredients: 24 Ingredients : Ferula asafoetida, Acorus calamus, Terminalia chebula, Punica granatum, Coriandrum sativum, Kaempferia galanga, Thrikatu, Thrilavanam, Soda carbonas impura (processed), Potassium carbonas Impura (processed)
Hinguvachadi Churna.safety_note: Contains alkaline salts; caution with hyperacidity; avoid in pregnancy unless advised.
Hinguvachadi Churna.evidence_note: Traditional use only; no robust clinical trials found.

Avipattikara Churna.ingredients: 11 Ingredients : Thrikatu, Thrijathakam, Cyperus rotundus, Embelia ribes, Emblica officinalis, Merrimia turpethum, Sugar
key_herbs: Trikatu: Shunthi (Zingiber officinale), Maricha (Piper nigrum), Pippali (Piper longum)
Triphala: Haritaki (Terminalia chebula), Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), Amalaki (Phyllanthus emblica)
Avipattikara Churna.safety_note: Purgative: avoid in pregnancy, diarrhoea or dehydration; sugar content matters for diabetics; Embelia and turpeth are not well studied for safety.
Avipattikara Churna.evidence_note: No good clinical trials of this specific formulation; support is traditional use and laboratory data.

Pushyanuga Churna.ingredients: 26 Ingredients : Cyclea peltata, Syzygium cumini, Mangifera indica (cotyledon), Rotula aquatica, Coscinium fenestratum, Symplocos cochinchinensis, Red ochre, Glycyrrhiza glabra, Terminalia arjuna
Pushyanuga Churna.safety_note: Licorice component can raise blood pressure/lower potassium with heavy use; avoid in pregnancy unless supervised; persistent abnormal bleeding needs medical diagnosis.
Pushyanuga Churna.evidence_note: No good clinical trials of this specific formulation; support is traditional use and laboratory data.

key_herbs: Rasna (Pluchea lanceolata, per general Ayurvedic sources; not verified on fetched pages)
Maharasnadi Kashayam.safety_note: Guduchi has been linked to herb-induced liver injury; avoid in autoimmune disease and pregnancy unless supervised.
Maharasnadi Kashayam.evidence_note: No good clinical trials of this specific formulation; support is traditional use and laboratory data.

Guduchyadi Kashayam.safety_note: Guduchi has been linked to liver injury in India; avoid with autoimmune disease or liver disease.
Guduchyadi Kashayam.evidence_note: No good clinical trials of this specific formulation; support is traditional use and laboratory data.

Nimbadi Kashayam.ingredients: 10 Ingredients : Azadirachta indica, Tinospora cordifolia, Zingiber officinale, Emblica officinalis, Terminalia chebula
Nimbadi Kashayam.safety_note: Neem may lower blood sugar and is traditionally avoided in pregnancy; neem oil is toxic to small children; guduchi has liver-injury reports.
Nimbadi Kashayam.evidence_note: Neem has insufficient clinical evidence; this decoction is untested.

Varanadi Kashayam.ingredients: 15 Ingredients & Indication : Same as Varanadi kashayachoornam
key_herbs: Varuna (Crateva nurvala; general Ayurvedic sources, not verified on fetched pages)
Varanadi Kashayam.evidence_note: No good clinical trials of this specific formulation; support is traditional use and laboratory data.

Gokshura Churna.safety_note: NCCIH-cited note: not proven safe; rare liver toxicity suggested; avoid in pregnancy; hormonal claims unproven.
Gokshura Churna.evidence_note: Controlled studies show no consistent testosterone effect; no strong human trials for urinary uses.

Guduchi Churna.safety_note: Supplement use has been linked to herb-induced liver injury in India, sometimes severe; avoid in autoimmune disease, liver disease and pregnancy; may lower blood sugar.
Guduchi Churna.evidence_note: Reviews find no good clinical evidence of benefit.

Arjuna Churna.safety_note: Safety is not well documented; use cautiously with cardiac medicines and seek medical care for heart disease.
Arjuna Churna.evidence_note: Wikipedia lists only preclinical studies; clinical evidence is limited.

Shatavari Churna.safety_note: Safety not well studied; avoid in pregnancy unless supervised; may affect blood sugar.
Shatavari Churna.evidence_note: Preliminary trials only; Wikipedia notes high-quality evidence is lacking.

Vacha Churna.safety_note: Contains beta-asarone, considered carcinogenic in animals; US FDA banned calamus in food in 1968; can cause vomiting; Ayurvedic purification lowers beta-asarone; avoid in pregnancy.
Vacha Churna.evidence_note: No clinical evidence of safety or efficacy.

Yashtimadhu Churna.safety_note: Glycyrrhizin can cause high blood pressure, low potassium and arrhythmia with long or heavy use; avoid in pregnancy, hypertension, heart or kidney disease; interacts with corticosteroids.
Yashtimadhu Churna.evidence_note: Weak, preliminary evidence (e.g. mouth rinses, sore throat); not enough to support any condition.

Sarpagandha Churna.safety_note: Contains reserpine-type alkaloids; can cause depression, nasal congestion, dizziness, GI upset; interacts with antihypertensives and antidepressants; avoid in depression, ulcer and pregnancy.
Sarpagandha Churna.evidence_note: Reserpine lowered systolic BP about 8 mmHg in a review; whole-root powder lacks trials.

Punarnava Churna.safety_note: Safety not documented in sources found; diuretic effect may interact with diuretics and affect kidney function.
Punarnava Churna.evidence_note: Only lab studies such as lunamarine in vitro; no human trials found.

Musta Churna.evidence_note: Little clinical evidence; traditional and laboratory data only.

Pippali Churna.safety_note: May cause heartburn; large amounts avoided in pregnancy and with stomach ulcers; may alter drug absorption (piperine, general knowledge).
Pippali Churna.evidence_note: No clinical trials for these uses on the pages reviewed.

Lasunadi Vati.ingredients: 8 Ingredients : Allium sativum, Cuminum cyminum, Sulphur, Zingiber officinalis etc
Lasunadi Vati.safety_note: Garlic may raise bleeding risk with anticoagulants and interact with some drugs; stop before surgery; contains processed sulphur.
Lasunadi Vati.evidence_note: Garlic evidence is mixed; no trials of this tablet.

Sanjeevani Vati.ingredients: 11 Ingredients : Embelia ribes, Zingiber officinalis, Thriphala, Acorus calamus etc
Sanjeevani Vati.safety_note: Formulations vary; some contain processed aconite (Vatsanabha), which is toxic if mis-processed; calamus contains beta-asarone; avoid in pregnancy.
Sanjeevani Vati.evidence_note: Traditional use; no robust human trials.

Dhanvantaram Gulika.ingredients: 16 Main Ingredients : Elettaria cardamomum, Dried ginger, Terminalia chebula, Cuminum cyminum, Elaeocarpus tuberculatus, Camphor, Rose water. 53 THERAPEUTIC INDEX
Dhanvantaram Gulika.safety_note: Contains camphor; avoid in infants and in pregnancy unless supervised.
Dhanvantaram Gulika.evidence_note: No trials found; traditional use only.

Vidangadi Gulika.ingredients: 4 Main Ingredients : Embelia ribes, Hibiscus rosasenensis, Ferula asafoetida
Vidangadi Gulika.safety_note: Embelia has been used as a contraceptive/abortifacient in some traditions; avoid in pregnancy; proprietary, not classical.
Vidangadi Gulika.evidence_note: Proprietary product, no trials found; weakly sourced.

Haridrakhanda.ingredients: 18 Main Ingredients : Curcuma longa, Cow milk, Cow ghee, Sugarcandy, Thrikatu, Chathurjathakam, Embelia ribes, Thriphala, Merrimia turpethum, Cyperus rotundus, Loha sindooram
Haridrakhanda.safety_note: Sugar content matters for diabetics; contains Loha bhasma (iron); turmeric supplements can rarely cause liver injury; avoid in pregnancy unless supervised.
Haridrakhanda.evidence_note: Turmeric evidence is weak; no trials of this formula.

Kantakaryavaleha.ingredients: 19 Ingredients : Solanum surattense, Tinospora cordifolia, Plumbago zeylanica, Cyperus rotundus, Zingiber officinale, Piper nigrum, Piper longum etc
Kantakaryavaleha.safety_note: Sugar/jaggery content; Solanum fruit is poisonous in raw form; guduchi liver-injury reports; plumbago (Chitraka) is irritant and avoided in pregnancy.
Kantakaryavaleha.evidence_note: Lab-level studies of Solanum only; no trials of this formula.

Lohasava.ingredients: 14 Main Ingredients : Iron (processed), Thrikatu, Thriphala, Cuminum cyminum, Embelia ribes, Cyperus rotundus, Plumbago rosea, Woodfordia fruiticosa, Honey, Jaggery
Lohasava.safety_note: Self-generated alcohol; contains processed iron (avoid with haemochromatosis, caution with iron supplements); heavy-metal contamination risk in some Ayurvedic products; avoid in pregnancy and with diabetes unless supervised.
Lohasava.evidence_note: No trials found; NCCIH notes evidence for Ayurveda is limited and metal safety is a concern.

Drakshadi Lehya.ingredients: 8 Main Ingredients : Raisins, Piper longum, Sugar, Glycyrrhiza glabra, Dried ginger, Curcuma angustifolia, Emblica officinalis, Honey
Drakshadi Lehya.safety_note: Sugar and honey content matters for diabetics; licorice component warrants caution with hypertension.

key_herbs: Dashamoola (ten roots; includes Aegle marmelos, Solanum virginianum, Tribulus terrestris)
Dashamoola Kashaya Churna.evidence_note: Ten roots in classical combination; no strong clinical data found.

Triphaladi Taila.ingredients: 37 Main Ingredients : Thriphala, Tinospora cordifolia, Pterocarpus marsupium, Emblica officinalis, Eclipta alba, Withania somnifera, Kaempferia galanga, Galena, Gingelly oil, Cow milk
Triphaladi Taila.safety_note: External use only; may cause cold or sinus congestion if applied wet or over long periods; caution with sensitive skin; contains galena (lead sulphide) per parsed record, a heavy-metal concern.
